original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Repair the PR2947 entry-budget test fixture on aliased temporary roots and replay every retained inventory/source/proof control without changing the frozen archive.
scope_change_reason: The production-adoption handoff exposed a native macOS replay error: its entry-budget fixture uses an unresolved TemporaryDirectory root while the helper compares resolved paths. Close this reproducible portability blocker before adoption.
bottleneck_link: A trustworthy native replay of the source-closure repair removes a concrete blocker to reviewing its adoption; this changes test transport only, not supplier mathematics.
stop_rule: Stop if the error does not reproduce on an explicitly aliased temporary root, or if a one-statement fixture adapter cannot pass all 59 original groups with no lost tests. No production adoption or full selected cold replay.
evidence: EVIDENCE.json: on native macOS with CPython 3.12.14 and 3.14.7, the unmodified full 59-group replay passes under canonical TMPDIR and errors only in the budget fixture under an explicit alias. The one-statement in-memory fixture correction passes all 59 groups with zero skips normally and under -O. Five adapter-control groups pass in both modes and versions.
